  • Management
  • - Originates in Aquatic ecosystems through excretion by fish
  • - Extremely toxic to fish
  • Harmful effects
  • - Ammonia occurs in two forms, unionized ammonia and ammonium ion
  • - As ammonia concentration in water increases , excretion of ammonia by aquatic animals
  • decrease
  • - Ammonia concentration in blood increases, causes increases in blood pH, affecting
  • metabolism
  • - Ammonia increases oxygen consumption by tissues, damages gills and reduces ability of
  • blood to transport oxygen
  • Management
  • - Maintain sufficient level of dissolved oxygen facilitates oxidation of ammonia
  • - Application of zeolite to absorb ammonia from bottom sediments
  • Origin of ammonia in culture ponds – (1 Mark)
  • Harmful effects of ammonia – (3 Marks)
